result: Release candidate v0.2.67 was refused before unit tests and build because @ai-matrx/design-system 0.44.5 was installed while npm latest had advanced to 0.44.6. This is a fresh publication, not the prior installed-lock mismatch.

package_evidence.source: CHANGELOG.md inside the published npm tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/@ai-matrx/design-system/-/design-system-0.44.6.tgz
package_evidence.change: Automatic changed-only republish for docs/metadata drift since 0.44.5; no source changes intended.
package_evidence.consumer_action: None. No extension code migration is required by this package release.
package_evidence.local_source_note: The aidream checkout changelog still starts at 0.44.5 at inspection time; the published tarball supplied the 0.44.6 entry.

next_step: The root owns the guarded @ai-matrx package refresh and release retry; preserve latest and keep the freshness gate enabled.

ui_test_dependency.observed_fact: The native sidepanel QA harness refuses an absent release receipt and verifies the released extension tree, manifest version, and Store ZIP hash before browser launch. Repeated package-freshness refusals therefore delay EXT-D-0018's native UI check even after the unit suite passes.
ui_test_dependency.followup_after_D18: Assess a separately attested local-build path for native extension QA so source-change UI tests can run before publication while retaining tree hash, manifest, extension identity, and owned-profile checks. Do not weaken the release-receipt path used for release verification.
ui_test_dependency.status: Observation and proposed follow-up only; no harness change in this lane.

limitations: Read-only npm metadata and published tarball inspection. No install, test, build, or harness run was performed in this lane.
